content:
"Hold On" is a song by Justin Bieber from his sixth studio album "Justice," released in 2021. Here are the key details:

## Release and Production
- Released as a single on March 5, 2021
- Written by Justin Bieber, Jon Bellion, Andrew Watt, Walter de Backer (Gotye), and Luiz Bonfá
- Produced by Andrew Watt and Jon Bellion
- The song samples/interpolates Gotye's "Somebody That I Used to Know"

## Musical Style and Themes
- It's a pop/pop-rock track with emotional vocals
- The lyrics deal with themes of perseverance, mental health, and supporting someone through difficult times
- Features a message of hope and resilience, encouraging listeners to "hold on" through hardship
- Part of the overall "Justice" album theme of healing and unity

## Music Video
- Directed by Colin Tilley
- Features actress Diane Keaton and Justin Bieber
- The video tells an emotional story about a couple dealing with terminal illness
- Has a narrative focusing on making the most of time together

## Commercial Performance
- Charted in multiple countries
- Reached the top 20 on the Billboard Hot 100
- Certified platinum in several countries

The song is considered one of the more emotionally resonant tracks from the "Justice" album, with its uplifting message resonating with fans during the challenging pandemic period when it was released.
